QuestInfo.name: Augury Heirloom
QuestInfo.1: Manji wants to test you to see if you're worthy of the Augury. Defeat 100 Iron Boars and 100 Fire Boars at the Burnt Lands in Perion.
QuestInfo.2: You collected the last Augury from Manji. Return to Vieren.

0.0: So you want to see the family heirloom? Why?\r\n#L0##bMy old master entrusted your family with the heirloom long ago.#l\n#k
0.1: Hm, just as I expected. The legend has been passed down from the older generations that someone will come for this Augury. Before I give this to you, though, I need to test you first.\r\n#L0##bA test?#l\n#k
0.2: I must be sure you are the one. And the one is surely strong. So defeat 100 Iron Boars and 100 Fire Boars in the Burnt Lands.

no.0: I simply cannot let you have the Heirloom if you don't pass my test.

1.0: Not bad. I see that you are worthy of taking this treasure, but I have one more question. What was the name of the organization you were a part of?\r\n#L0##bAurora. I am sure that's the name you expected to hear.#l\n#k

yes.0: Take good care of it. I'll be taking my leave now.

mob.0: You have yest to pass my test. What are you doing here?
